title: 19-BCV-024(REV1) - Schedules of professional involvement
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); recognizes schedules in National Building Code – 2023 Alberta Edition

facts.text: Revision 1 recognizes 2023 Alberta Edition professional-involvement schedules as an alternative to 2019 Division C Articles 2.4.3.1., 2.4.3.2., and 2.4.4.1.
Its application covers projects requiring schedules under those 2019 Division C articles.

The variance permits the 2023 Appendix B schedules and lets projects already started using the earlier 19-BCV-024 Appendix A schedules complete with them; it includes a note about the coordinating professional reference in schedule fields.
facts.locator: Same PDF, p. 3, Variance and Note
